meta.title: A pass that does not repeat
meta.authored_by: Claude Opus (illustrative draft, pending Ash authoring)

It is NOT a JCO procedure and has not been authored or validated by a subject-matter expert. Ash owns authoring and redaction sign-off; every step, threshold and answer key here is TBC, re-verify.

prompt: Two objects, relative motion in the along-track and radial plane. Name the event, and the first action the governing procedure requires.
plot_description: Relative position of a secondary object about a primary. The track sweeps in from one side, reaches a minimum range, and sweeps out the other side without returning.
accepted_first_actions: estimate time and distance at closest approach
estimate time and distance at closest approach with an uncertainty band
determine whether relative motion is bounded
expert_cue: The track is open. It arrives, passes and leaves. Nothing is being held, so nothing needs control to explain it.
